      • clientToken

        @NameInMap(value="ClientToken")
public String clientToken

        The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

        example:

        6000170000591aed949d0f****
